recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat FHIR-8065 as historically applied and superseded by later medication-form terminology maintenance; future form-binding questions should follow the FHIR-19296 family rather than the DSTU1 route-of-administration correction.
issue_request: FHIR-8065 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy correction reporting that Medication.product.form pointed to route-of-administration value-set contents and requesting the binding use SNOMED CT concept is-a 421967003.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was fixed in svn 6615. The corresponding git-svn commit c74b8e3ebbf92ccc157a591a1571158559a655cd changed source/medication/valueset-medication-form-codes.xml from 284009009 to 421967003, matching the requested correction.
additional_context: Medication is active in the current build, but Medication.product.form has since become Medication.doseForm. Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-19296 changed the same drug form binding to SNOMED CT 736542009, Pharmaceutical Dose Form, and is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit 3f8121c74ce427b4f97c621f41f9355c4a81a84d.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current Medication.doseForm binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-form-codes, whose source filters SNOMED CT is-a 736542009; the original route-of-administration error is absent, and reverting to 421967003 would contradict FHIR-19296.
